cases.title: Operation Nightfall - Source Review
cases.description: A fictional distributor reports that three consignments marked for Noida were dispatched to a Gurugram holding yard. Warehouse logs and ordinary supplier payments are interleaved with a disputed after-hours pickup. Current uncertainty: The dispatch clerk recalls a white van at 20:15. The visitor ledger records a grey utility vehicle at 20:32; the clerk could not read its plate. Next review: Preserve the original visitor ledger and obtain a second independent account before identifying an occupant. All records are fictional.
cases.description_hi: यह पूरी तरह काल्पनिक जाँच है। स्रोत समय, वैकल्पिक स्पष्टीकरण और विरोधी बयान अलग-अलग दर्ज हैं। कोई निष्कर्ष दोष सिद्ध नहीं करता।
openQuestions: The dispatch clerk recalls a white van at 20:15. The visitor ledger records a grey utility vehicle at 20:32; the clerk could not read its plate.
Preserve the original visitor ledger and obtain a second independent account before identifying an occupant.

cases.title: Operation Northbridge - Source Review
cases.description: A fictional courier audit finds two delivery receipts bearing the same reference but different arrival times. The inquiry tests whether this reflects a routine reprint, delayed synchronization or a substituted delivery. Current uncertainty: The recipient remembers an early delivery. A gate supervisor describes a later vehicle arrival but did not inspect the parcel. Next review: Compare source clocks and receipt revision history; the shared contact with Nightfall is only a review lead. All records are fictional.

cases.title: Operation Copper Ledger - Source Review
cases.description: A fictional procurement team reports unmatched credit notes against copper-component invoices. Several large payments coincide with quarter-end settlement, so an amount threshold alone cannot determine improper activity. Current uncertainty: The accounts assistant says the batch included two legitimate refunds. A purchasing note lists only one supporting credit reference. Next review: Request refund authorizations and reconcile invoice totals before interpreting the payment pattern. All records are fictional.

cases.title: Operation River Signal - Source Review
cases.description: A fictional service contractor cannot reconcile equipment movements between Dwarka and Faridabad. Communications include routine maintenance calls and a concentrated exchange before a depot handover. Current uncertainty: A technician recalls returning the equipment on Monday. The receiving log was entered Tuesday and may record intake rather than occurrence. Next review: Separate handover occurrence time from data-entry time and review the equipment serial inventory. All records are fictional.

Next review: Obtain the roster revision and preserve original access exports without inferring identity from proximity. All records are fictional.

cases.title: Operation Summit Voucher - Source Review
cases.description: A fictional accounts team finds vouchers missing supporting travel notes. The approval message shows the original date and does not document the revision. Next review: Compare itinerary changes and authorization messages before classifying the expense. All records are fictional.

cases.title: Operation Ember Transfer - Source Review
cases.description: A fictional parts depot reports a mismatch between a stock-transfer sheet and receiving count. Partial deliveries and unit-conversion differences are plausible alternatives to diversion. Current uncertainty: The dispatch team counted sealed boxes. The recipient recorded individual units and noted one damaged seal without identifying an occupant. Next review: Reconcile units and packaging, preserve the receiving sheet and seek independent seal observations. All records are fictional.
